title: Choose pod-god's workspace composition
question: Choose the closest north star. In the note, tell me what should carry forward, what feels false, or what you want combined or revised.

options.label: A — Three-Zone Console
options.thesis: A stable production navigator, dominant chat, and always-visible contextual workbench keep the whole show legible at once.
options.viewport: Left workflow rail, central conversation, right episode workbench, persistent bottom transport.
options.risk: Most complete at a glance, but three columns can feel dense on smaller desktops.

options.label: B — Stacked Studio Deck
options.thesis: Conversation stays wide while the active production surface becomes a tactile deck below it.
options.viewport: Wide chat and episode status above, horizontal production stages and transport below.
options.risk: The lower deck reduces transcript height and creates a heavier desktop-first composition.

options.label: C — Focus Canvas + Tool Drawer
options.thesis: Chat owns the workspace; one contextual production tool appears only when requested.
options.viewport: Slim icon rail, stage progress above, dominant chat center, full-height contextual drawer, compact transport below.
options.risk: Best focus, but deeper production controls need unmistakable discovery cues.
